caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair positioned at an angle, allowing both the front and side to be visible. The chair is made of brown wood with visible grain and texture throughout its surface. The seat is flat and rectangular with rounded front edges, and the legs are straight with simple joinery, showing pegs or bolts at connection points. The backrest consists of two horizontal slats, one at the top and one near the middle, each featuring distinct geometric carvings or patterns, including zigzags and triangular shapes. The legs and frame also display slight irregularities, suggesting the wood may be roughly hewn. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or scenery present.
